title: Principal thickening ideal factorization
statement: For any commutative ring R, g in R, open W of Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and natural c,n such that every g-power-torsion element of R is killed by g^c, put mu_k equal to multiplication by the restricted g^(k+1) on O_W and I_k=image(mu_k). There exists an O_W-linear map d:I_(n+c) -> O_W with d followed by mu_n equal to the image inclusion I_(n+c) -> O_W. No H^1 vanishing or section-lifting assertion is made.

proof.text: For any localization S of R, write z=r/s using IsLocalization.surj. If g^j*z=0, the localization zero criterion gives a denominator t with t*g^j*r=0. The uniform hypothesis kills t*r by g^c; the same criterion gives g^c*z=0. Apply this to the localizations R_p identified with stalks of Spec R. The open-immersion stalk isomorphism transports the restricted scalar to algebraMap g. Stalkwise section separation then proves the bound on every open of W, so multiplication by g^c kills the kernel sheaf of mu_(n+c).

In the abelian category of O_W-modules, image(mu_(n+c)) is canonically the cokernel of kernel(mu_(n+c)). Descend multiplication by g^c to d using that cokernel universal property and the coimage-image isomorphism. Precompose d followed by mu_n with the epi O_W -> image(mu_(n+c)); the scalar identity g^c*g^(n+1)=g^((n+c)+1) proves the required equation, which follows by cancelling that epi.

proof_origin.note: Lean implementation and second reading: localization zero criterion, stalkwise separation, and abelian coimage-image descent; original route retained.

mathlib_searches.results: coimageIsoImage, coimageImageComparison and generic image/coimage factorization results; none establishes the localized scalar-torsion bound.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Second reader: categorical descent tools exist, but not this geometric bounded-torsion theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: If all power torsion of a scalar is annihilated by a fixed power, multiplication by that power descends from the image of a higher scalar endomorphism to the structure sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Module.p_pow_smul_lift requires a PID/domain; torsion pOrder and affine localization results, including exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_basicOpen_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen and ModuleCat.Tilde.smul_stalk_no_nonzero_divisor, are only component tools.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Second reader: no exact sheaf-image factorization over an arbitrary commutative ring.

lean.statement:
theorem principal_thickening_ideal_factor
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (c n : ℕ)
    (hkill : ∀ (j : ℕ) (s : R), g ^ j * s = 0 → g ^ c * s = 0) :
    ∃ d : principalThickeningIdeal R g W (n + c) ⟶
        SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf,
      d ≫ principalThickeningMultiplication R g W n =
        image.ι (principalThickeningMultiplication R g W (n + c))
